relation_to_primary.purpose: post-hoc descriptive decomposition of short-budget grounded-feedback value into availability and ranking components

availability.external_available: sub_exists is true and sub_score is finite
availability.stdout_available: val_how equals keyed and stdout_val is finite

policies.uniform: uniform expected truth over every candidate
policies.external_then_uniform: argmax oriented external score; if no external candidate, uniform over every candidate
policies.stdout_then_uniform: argmax oriented keyed stdout; if no keyed stdout candidate, uniform over every candidate
policies.external_then_stdout_then_uniform: argmax oriented external score when any exists; otherwise argmax keyed stdout; otherwise uniform

decomposition.full_oracle: maximum y_norm over every candidate under the parent
decomposition.restricted_oracle: maximum y_norm over candidates available to the policy; uniform expected truth when none are available
decomposition.tie_handling: uniform expected truth across all signal maxima within absolute tolerance 1e-12
decomposition.hybrid_available_set: union of external-available and stdout-available candidates

paired_contrasts: external advantage over stdout = stdout total regret minus external total regret
hybrid advantage over stdout = stdout total regret minus hybrid total regret
